 Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch update 23.5.0 out now, patch notes – new gifting feature and more
 Posted on November 9, 2026 by Brian ( @NE_Brian )
 in News , Switch , Switch 2 
 Nintendo just released a new system update for Switch 2 and Switch, with both systems moving up to version 23.5.0.
 The main addition here is the inclusion of a new gifting feature, which goes live on November 17, 2026. With it, you can gift Nintendo eShop products to a Nintendo Account family group member. The feature will be available on both Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch.
 There are a few other things here as well, including some aspects related to accessibility. Of course, general adjustments and fixes are also included.
 The full rundown can be found below. Note that the bits about accessibility only apply to Nintendo Switch 2 systems.
 Nintendo Switch 2 and Switch update version 23.5.0 patch notes
 Added the ability to configure accessibility settings during first-time setup. Information on these accessibility settings can be found in Nintendo Switch 2 first-time setup .
 Added support for an upcoming feature to allow gifting of Nintendo eShop products to a Nintendo Account family group member. This gifting feature will be available after a Nintendo eShop update, scheduled for November 17, 2026. 
 The following updates have been made in Accessibility in System Settings: Added Portuguese (Portugal) to “Text to Speech” languages.
 Added Portuguese (Portugal) to the GameChat “Convert Text to Speech” languages.
 General adjustments and fixes were made to improve the user experience.
 The last major Nintendo Switch 2 update was version 23.0.0 in September . It came with VRR support in docked mode for Nintendo switch 2, Mii Maker music, and more.
